verdict.rationale: Name.com documents an API endpoint that returns an alphabetical list of all supported TLDs with pricing per TLD and order type, so TLD coverage is enumerable. The evidence does not show how many TLDs that is, and nothing documents per-TLD special requirements for restricted or country-code extensions. Missing for 10: evidence of 'hundreds' of extensions, per-TLD documentation of restricted-TLD or ccTLD registration requirements, independent corroboration of TLD breadth.

support.subject: As a power user, the registrar carries the TLDs I actually want — hundreds of extensions with any special requirements (restricted TLDs, country codes) documented per TLD

citations.quote: This endpoint returns an alphabetical list of all TLDs supported by name.com, including pricing for each supported order type.
name.com provides three pricing types for each TLD
